fd.caveat: flow_proxy_veh_h is density*speed*lanes from instantaneous vehicle states; use detector/passage flow for final FD calibration.

ramp_metering.caveat: Short or underfed ramp runs can underestimate capacity; final fit needs sustained queue at the meter.

signal_saturation.caveat: Use high-demand saturated approaches before treating this as signal saturation flow.

urban_mfd.caveat: This uses signal stopline discharge as a production proxy; final MFD should use validated protected-region production counts.

mpc_weight_tuning.next: Tune after FD, ramp, signal, and MFD physical calibration pass acceptance checks.
